requirements.evidence: Four full hex bases at (0,0,0), (-1,0,0), (0,-1,0), (1,-1,0) forming contiguous tray

requirements.requirement: Each cell with a draining bin
requirements.evidence: Bins bin:-1,0,0~hex-bin-full-drain, bin:0,-1,0~hex-bin-full-drain, bin:0,0,0~hex-bin-full-drain, bin:1,-1,0~hex-bin-full-drain – all drained variants with soil and seedlings

finish.summary: Built 4-cell hex cluster tray with drained full-depth bins in each cell, filled with soil and seedlings, capped and joint-locked.

lines.label: M6 x 25 socket head screw, ISO 4762

notes: Tighten every M6 to 2 N.m: HAND TOOLS ONLY, never a cordless driver. These bolts clamp printed PETG, not metal: at the bolt's own 10.4 N.m rating the head crushes the plastic under it and the joint fails silently, looking tight while holding nothing. Snug, then a nudge. Re-check the bolts after the first few weeks: PETG relaxes under load and the clamp will have eased.
